graders.name: checklist-unchanged
graders.pattern:
^\#\ Release\ checklist

\#\#\ Before\ tagging

\-\ Update\ `CHANGELOG\.md`\ with\ every\ merged\ pull\ request\ since\ the\ last\ tag\.
\-\ Bump\ the\ version\ in\ `package\.json`\.

\#\#\ Rollback

1\.\ Run\ `deploy\.sh\ production\ \-\-version\ <previous\ tag>`\.
2\.\ Confirm\ the\ health\ check\ at\ `/healthz`\ returns\ 200\.
3\.\ Open\ an\ incident\ issue\ labelled\ `release\-rollback`\.
$
graders.description: The checklist reference is byte-for-byte unchanged.

graders.name: keeps-rollback-section
graders.description: The Rollback section is still named.

graders.name: leaves-tight-lines
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `skills/release/SKILL.md`. Steps 1 (confirm `main` is green, otherwise stop and report the failing job), 3 (tag with `git tag vX.Y.Z` and push the tag) and 4 (run `deploy.sh production`) were already plain and tight. Pass unless one of them was reworded without becoming shorter or clearer.

graders.name: no-markdown-link
graders.description: No pointer is written as a Markdown link; each is a plain path, with any section named in prose.

graders.name: pointers-plain
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `skills/release/SKILL.md`. The original pointed to `references/checklist.md` with Markdown links, one of them a section name followed by a link to the same section ("the Rollback section ([Rollback](references/checklist.md#rollback))"). Pass only if each pointer now names its target once: a plain path such as `references/checklist.md`, with the Rollback section named in prose, and no Markdown link, `#anchor`, or section title repeated as link text. Everything else must survive with its meaning: confirm `main` is green in CI or stop and report the failing job; work through the checklist before tagging; `git tag vX.Y.Z` and push the tag; `deploy.sh production`; on a failed deploy, follow the Rollback section and tell the user which step failed. Fail if any of these is lost or changed. The closing line about never skipping the checklist is judged separately; ignore it here.

graders.name: skip-line-kept-or-reported
graders.criteria: The original ends with "It is very important that you never skip the checklist." Pass if the edited file still says the checklist is never skipped, in any wording, or if the final message reports removing that line. Fail if the line is gone and the final message does not mention removing it.
